intent: Sustained forward trot at 0.1 m/s on level ground using a diagonal-pair gait (A=RF+LR, B=RR+LF) with direct smooth joint trajectories, constant base height, and declared diagonal stance contacts.

phases.name: stance_A_swing_B
phases.base_motion: Constant forward velocity 0.1 m/s along world x, y=0, constant z=0.04673357 m, zero roll/pitch/yaw.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A (RF,LR) in stance: hips sweep cos wave, knees held at stance flex 0.148 rad (R3=L4=pi-0.148). Pair B (RR,LF) in swing: hips cos wave offset half cycle, knees flex up to 0.148+0.558 rad via normalized sine arch sin(pi*s), s in [0,1].

phases.name: stance_B_swing_A
phases.base_motion: Same constant forward velocity, height, and zero attitude.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B (RR,LF) in stance: knees at 0.148 rad (R4=L3=0.148). Pair A (RF,LR) in swing: knees flex up to 0.148+0.558 rad with normalized sine arch; hips continue cos wave.

coding_notes: Parameters: freq=2.50 Hz, hip amplitude A=0.272 rad, hip center=1.602 rad, stance knee flex=0.148 rad, swing knee lift=0.558 rad, phase origin=0.118, base height=0.04673357 m. Phase pA = frac(freq*t + 0.118); pB = frac(pA+0.5). Hips: R1=center+A*cos(2pi*pA); R2=pi-center+A*cos(2pi*pB); L1=pi-center-A*cos(2pi*pB); L2=center-A*cos(2pi*pA). Knees: flexA=where(pA>=0.5, 0.148+0.558*sin(pi*(pA-0.5)*2), 0.148); flexB analogous with pB. R3=pi-flexA, L4=pi-flexA, R4=flexB, L3=flexB. q order R1,R3,R2,R4,L1,L3,L2,L4. Contacts: contactA=pA<0.5, contactB=pB<0.5; contacts=[contactA,contactB,contactB,contactA]. Root: x=0.1*t, y=0, z=0.04673357 constant; rpy all zero. No clipping, no base ripple, no projection. Normalize swing phase before sine to avoid wrap discontinuity.
